title: Finite-free sheaf model gives a module model on one principal open
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], and $M$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules. Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for structure-sheaf modules on $X$ and all its localized open sites in one morphism universe, and for $A_f$-modules in an independently chosen morphism universe. Let $f\in A$ and let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $D(f)\subseteq U$. Suppose a complex $P$ of structure-sheaf modules on the localized site of $U$ is zero in all degrees above some integer, every term is isomorphic to a free sheaf on a finite set, and $Q(P)$ is isomorphic to the derived restriction to $U$ of $Q(\widetilde M)$. Then $Q(A_f\otimes_A M)$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]: it is isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $A_f$-modules. No finite cover of $X$ is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 08E7 (perfect-lemma-pseudo-coherent-affine), converse proof, local-model comparison; Tag 06Z0 for the affine derived comparison

proof.text: Restrict the supplied complex $P$ and its derived isomorphism along $D(f)\subseteq U$. Restriction to an open is exact, so it computes derived restriction termwise and preserves zero objects. Finite free sheaves restrict to finite free sheaves with the same ranks. Identify the open scheme $D(f)$ with $\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)$.

The associated sheaf of $N$ restricted to $D(f)$ identifies naturally with the associated sheaf of $A_f\otimes_A N$: both have the same localized modules and restriction maps on the principal-open basis. Apply this natural comparison degreewise to $M$ and its differentials.

Under the tilde/Gamma adjunction on $\operatorname{Spec}(A_f)$, each finite free term of the restricted $P$ corresponds to a finite free $A_f$-module of the same rank. Full faithfulness lifts its differentials, and faithfulness proves their square-zero identities. The resulting module complex $L$ vanishes above the supplied upper bound.

Both associated-sheaf complexes have quasi-coherent cohomology. Lift their isomorphism to the full quasi-coherent derived subcategory and reflect it through the affine derived equivalence over $A_f$. This gives $Q(L)\cong Q(A_f\otimes_A M)$, as required by ring pseudo-coherence. If $D(f)$ is empty, $A_f$ is the zero ring and the zero complex works. This is a single-open comparison and performs no finite-cover extraction or gluing.

theorem affine_pseudoCoherent_principal_model (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wL} (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (P.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hiso : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) :
    DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))
